provenance.capturedBy: hand-transcribed from the incident writeup in DRO-1163; not an automated capture
provenance.note: Live evidence showed eight globally registered plugin tools, non-empty ctx.runtimeMcp, an injected managed gateway config, an unused run-scoped credential, and github_bot_whoami reported unavailable. The core follow-up found the generated Codex config used unsupported headers instead of http_headers, so Codex discarded the credential. No raw tools/list or transport capture was preserved; whether an unauthenticated request reached the gateway is unknown.
